requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct surface_area filter.
User wants the property located near public transport. Proximity expressed, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of mobility (70.93), rounded to 71.
The project is a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is clearly necessary. Threshold is the 75th percentile of education (75.14), rounded to 75.

The user wants an energy class C or better, so the filter includes A1, A2, A3, A4, B and C. Square meters, capacity, Turin location and public transport access are not energy requirements and are excluded.
